objective: Test one materially distinct public-market-data M4 signal candidate; no performance grid run in this record.
market: Binance USDⓈ-M public market data; no orders or account endpoints

candidate.mechanism: After a higher-timeframe BTC regime filter, a lower-timeframe opposite-side aggressive trade burst followed by same-side top-five displayed-depth replenishment may identify liquidity absorption and predict target-first continuation with the macro regime.
candidate.trade_geometry: 1R target; stop one tick beyond adverse price in qualifying burst; max hold 20 timeframe bars; stop-first unresolved ties.
candidate.confidence: Fixed logistic model plus separate chronological sigmoid calibration; exact implementation and sample-count gate remain to be frozen before labels are inspected.

raw_20_symbol_linear_storage_estimate.note: Linear extrapolation from two symbols and one hour of uncompressed depth@500ms plus aggTrade JSONL; not a measured 20-symbol rate. Do not launch a long raw capture at this scale.

compression_probe.method: stream zstd -q -c to byte counter; no compressed file was written
compression_probe.note: Measured on this one-hour two-symbol JSONL file only. Linear projection remains an estimate; even this ratio projects to about 3.87 decimal TB/year, so compression alone is not a sufficient retention plan.

next_action: Implement and locally verify a compact, sequence-valid feature recorder and deterministic replay; then freeze full hashes, universe, calibration sample counts, costs and forward partitions before collecting any outcome-bearing study data.
